summary: Tested ECO Building Technik (German dark-mode site). Backend: 10/10 pytest passing for products (34), categories (6), filters, single product, 404, inquiry, contact, stats. Frontend: home, shop, product detail, contact form, navigation (Start/Shop/Energie-Rechner/Ueber uns/Kontakt), mobile menu, search filter, energy calculator all render and work. Contact form submits successfully end-to-end. Add-to-cart from home and product detail works.

minor.issue: Returns {service, version} but no 'message' field - inconsistent with conventional FastAPI root response (cosmetic)

ui_bugs.issue: Multiple product images broken (alt text visible): Squirrel M30 Gas-Boiler 25kW/30kW/35kW, Smart LED-Streifen 5m RGBW, Smart LED-Deckenleuchte 36W, Smart LED-Lampe E27 RGBW, Smart LED-Lampe GU10 RGBW. Image URLs in seed data either invalid or return 404.
No data-testid='cart-button' attribute on header cart icon - testability gap (functionality works as cart drawer opens via icon click)

issues: Category filter chips visible (Alle/Wärmepumpen/Gas-Brennwert/Smart Home/Beleuchtung/Energiemanagement/Wasser) but lack data-testid attributes for testability

action_items: Fix broken product images for Squirrel M30 25/30/35kW, Smart LED-Streifen 5m, Smart LED-Deckenleuchte 36W, Smart LED-Lampe E27/GU10 (replace image URLs in seed data in /app/backend/server.py)
Add data-testid='cart-button' to header cart icon button for E2E testing reliability
Add data-testid to category filter chips on /shop (e.g., data-testid='category-filter-waermepumpen')
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single file - if it grows beyond ~700 lines, split into routers/models/seed modules.
Inquiry model has 'customer_name' while contact uses 'name' - inconsistent naming across similar customer-info endpoints.
Several products in seed data reference image URLs that 404 - should be validated at seed time or replaced with stable Unsplash URLs.
seed_data_creation: Used TEST_ prefix for inquiry and contact submissions in tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py works against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Inquiry uses field 'customer_name' (not 'name'), Product uses 'price_from' (not 'price'), Category uses 'key' (not 'slug'). Cart button on header lacks data-testid - find via header icon. Several product images in seed data are broken (404).
rca of the issue: Broken images: seed data in server.py contains image URLs (likely Unsplash photo IDs) that no longer resolve. Reproduction: load /shop, observe alt text rendered for ~7 products. Mitigation: replace image fields in seed_products() with verified working URLs or fall back to a category-based default image.
